title: Hard-Edge Determinant Fields and Second-Moment Universality for Random Matrix Ratios
summary: We study the microscopic spectrum at the origin of ratios of independent complex Girko matrices. Under bounded-density and finite-moment assumptions, together with circular second-moment matching, we prove compact-uniform convergence of the normalized determinants to a random entire function constructed from the complex hard edge and an independent Ginibre array. The zero divisor of this limiting determinant field has the law of the infinite complex Ginibre process.
